title: Follow the installed OS-specific procedure
when: User agrees that dedicated machine coverage is needed
need: Use the installed Pack version: dedicated account, SSH open to any address with key-only auth and the desktop direct over the tailnet (SSH forward as the fallback), named test-machine settings, workstation-local SSH/desktop secrets, required tools/sign-ins and effective desktop permissions. Supported recipes cover macOS, Ubuntu 24.04 and Windows through WSL2; native Windows Yoke is not this fixture. Before capture follow the project-owned manual runtime inventory; Yoke's guide includes Docker/Compose and portable Mac external-state preparation. For Ubuntu and WSL, desktop provisioning selects xfce4-terminal and the Yoke identity browser using XFCE helpers. From the retained XFCE desktop, verify both the default terminal and an HTTPS link in the authorized identity browser. Retain every credential/GUI check.
surface: Pack README → host-provisioning → per-OS procedure; settings contract.
gap: Setup support exists; improve discovery instead of building another provisioner. Keep project-specific infrastructure/accounts and private fixture policy out of a universal user recipe.
review: Source guidance updated; provisioning evidence distinguishes passing runtime/restores from unresolved Windows desktop proof.
